summary: We recommend focusing on your message.

recommendations.title: Rewrite the hero section around the customer outcome.
recommendations.whatToDo: Rewrite the hero section of your homepage or primary landing page(s) so it is centered around the customer’s primary outcome, not just your company, service, or process.
recommendations.doneWhen: The primary hero communicates the customer outcome.

recommendations.title: Extract customer language from real conversations.
recommendations.whatToDo: Review sales calls, testimonials, reviews, emails, and support questions for repeated language.
recommendations.doneWhen: Repeated customer phrases are extracted from direct evidence.

recommendations.title: Add proof immediately after major claims.
recommendations.whatToDo: Support claims with results, reviews, testimonials, examples, credentials, or demonstrations.
recommendations.doneWhen: Major claims have relevant proof immediately after them.
